source_refs.note: Topic IPv4 and IPv6 as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 15, printed 10); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: IPv4 is an older version of IP addressing. It uses 32-bit numeric addresses. IPv4 has a limited number of addresses. IPv6 is the newer version with 128-bit addresses. IPv6 provides more address space. It supports modern Internet needs.
